title: Guiding Diffusion-based Reconstruction with Contrastive Signals for Balanced Visual Representation
role: A working CLIP-style contrastive loss computed in a frozen diffusion model's noise-prediction space, with one shared noisy latent per contrast; it trains the condition encoder, the reverse direction of a score-path encoder
reads: Full SD2.1 noise prediction eps(x_t, h(f(x)), t) at one shared noisy latent and one uniformly drawn timestep, conditioned on a projected CLIP [CLS] token; no unconditional subtraction
trains: CLIP vision encoder (LoRA rank 16) and a two-layer MLP projector, two stages, on CC3M, batch 16, 4,600 steps, contrastive loss on noise predictions; SD2.1 frozen
combines: Cosine similarity inside an InfoNCE loss: anchor eps vs positives (augmented-view eps and true noise) vs negatives (eps under other batch images' conditions), all at the same x_t and t
adding: not addressed; only assumes the map from CLIP feature to noise prediction is bi-Lipschitz at fixed t (unchecked)
noise_and_seed: not addressed as a measurement; one noise draw per image, the same x_t reused for anchor, positive and all negatives; no seeds or variances reported
timesteps: not measured; t drawn uniformly from 1 to T
unseen: no; trained on CC3M and evaluated zero-shot on six other datasets with no concept split; MMVP-VLM counting rises 20.0 to 26.7 and positional/relational falls 13.3 to 6.7 points on OpenAI ViT-L@224
headline: MMVP-VLM average accuracy 33.3% against 32.6% (un2CLIP) and 19.2% (original) on OpenAI CLIP ViT-L@224; average clustering NMI 0.76 against 0.71 (0 to 1); frozen SD2.1
suggests: (inferred) Build each score-path contrastive batch from paths that share one seed and differ only in condition, as DCR shares x_t, and contrast d_t rather than full eps so the shared part does not dominate cosine
model: SD2.1 (frozen, main); SD-1.4, SD-1.5, SD-XL in ablation; CLIP ViT-L/H, SigLIP encoders
